offering_description.value: Provides broadband internet, local telephone, and video services to rural homes and businesses through its local telephone companies in the United States. Delivers service over its own copper and fiber networks in small communities where larger carriers have limited presence.

primary_services.value: broadband internet access; local telephone service; video service; business data and networking; long distance

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households in rural communities buying internet, phone and video; B2B: rural businesses, schools and institutions, and other carriers buying access and data services

end_markets.value: consumer telecommunications; rural broadband; business communications

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly fees for internet, telephone and video service; transaction or usage fees: access and long distance charges paid by other carriers and customers; service fees: installation, equipment and business network services; other: federal universal service support for rural telephone networks
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; other

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells telephone, internet and video service to households and businesses; asset operator: owns and runs local copper and fiber networks in its service areas

geography_served.value: US regional: rural communities in several US states, mainly in the Midwest and other rural regions

specialization.value: related lines: local telephone, broadband internet, video and business data services over shared networks

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales and service staff serving local households and businesses

regulatory_exposure.value: high: regulated local telephone carrier needing state utility commission oversight and FCC rules

notes: Exact list of states served and the mix of service areas are uncertain.
